skill.description: Generate hosted AI videos from text prompts through Luxin, with model guidance, job recovery, cost receipts, and durable media URLs.

skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection language was found. The skill directs agents to execute remote commands and unpinned packages, creating command-control and supply-chain risks. Hosted persistence, diagnostic sharing, and an image-specific spending flag add privacy and billing concerns.

remediation.issue: The guide can return data.next_command for the agent to execute.
remediation.suggestion: Parse allowlisted response fields and construct fixed command arguments locally. Require confirmation before every returned command.

remediation.issue: The examples execute unpinned packages through npx with automatic approval.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions and verify package integrity. Remove automatic approval where an interactive confirmation is possible.

remediation.issue: The video command uses an image-specific estimated spending flag.
remediation.suggestion: Use a documented video spending limit and verify that the service rejects jobs exceeding the approved amount.

remediation.issue: Hosted jobs and feedback can retain prompts, commands, and diagnostic details.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose retention behavior, redact sensitive values, and require explicit approval before sending feedback.

content.user_title: Create Hosted AI Videos with Luxin
content.value_statement: Video generation often requires provider accounts, credentials, and separate billing. This skill uses Luxin to create hosted videos through one guided CLI workflow.
actual_capabilities: Starts a no-spend guide for a selected Luxin video model.
Creates hosted videos from text prompts through the Luxin CLI.
Returns durable media URLs, recoverable job records, and cost receipts.
Supports model discovery and readiness checks before generation.
Provides a hosted feedback command for missing capabilities and runtime issues.
limitations: Requires network access and downloads current npm packages in the documented commands.
Depends on Luxin service availability, supported models, policies, and payment options.
Video generation may consume credits and requires explicit spending approval.
Prompts, outputs, jobs, and submitted feedback are processed by a hosted service.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Motion
use_cases.description: Create a short hosted product reveal and retain its URL for reviews or presentations.

use_cases.title: Draft Social Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate motion concepts from campaign prompts while checking model choice and estimated cost first.

use_cases.title: Automate Recoverable Video Jobs
use_cases.description: Start video jobs, inspect receipts, and recover hosted outputs across agent sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Short Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ten-second hosted video of [subject] performing [action]. Use the guide first and show the estimated cost before any paid generation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Video Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare available Luxin video models for [goal]. Recommend one based on quality, speed, and estimated cost without starting a paid job.

prompt_templates.title: Generate and Track a Campaign Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [duration] campaign clip using [model] and this prompt: [prompt]. Confirm spending permission, then report job status, cost, and hosted URL.

prompt_templates.title: Recover and Diagnose a Video Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Recover the Luxin job for [project or job identifier]. Summarize its status, receipt, output URL, and missing capability. Submit redacted feedback only after approval.

output_examples.input: Create a ten-second handheld product reveal after showing the estimated cost.
output: Spending approval is required before generation.
After completion, the result includes job status, cost receipt, and hosted video URL.

output_examples.input: Recover my previous campaign clip and explain why it failed.
output_examples.output: The job summary identifies its current state, available receipt, hosted output, and missing capability. Sensitive details remain excluded from feedback.

best_practices: Run the no-spend guide before creating media or authorizing credits.
Pin CLI package versions and review every generated command before execution.
Remove confidential details from prompts and feedback sent to the hosted service.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a returned next command without validating its arguments and confirming spend.
Do not place provider credentials or private customer data in prompts or feedback.
Do not assume an image-specific cost option limits video generation charges.

faq.question: Does this skill require provider API keys?
faq.answer: No provider key is required. Luxin uses a hosted identity and shared credit workflow.

faq.question: Can I inspect costs before generating a video?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with the guide and require an estimate plus explicit approval before any paid command.

faq.question: Where are generated videos stored?
faq.answer: Luxin stores generated work as hosted media with durable URLs and recoverable job records.

faq.question: Can the skill work without network access?
faq.answer: No. The CLI, hosted API, model runtime, and media URLs require network access.

faq.question: Which video models are supported?
faq.answer: Support depends on Luxin model availability. The examples use fal.ltx-video-13b-distilled.

faq.question: What should I include in feedback?
faq.answer: Include the attempted action and observed behavior after removing prompts, tokens, customer data, and other sensitive details.
